A more polished, more reassuring interface — and a little celebration when your upload lands.

## Added

- **Confetti when an upload finishes.** The moment an upload reaches 100% and the
  share link appears, a short gold/violet confetti burst celebrates it. It's
  loaded lazily (no weight on first paint) and turns itself off for visitors who
  prefer reduced motion.

## Changed

- **One consistent floating-glass design.** The result panel (after upload) and
  the download page now wear the same frosted, elevated glass surface as the
  drop zone, so every screen feels like one piece.
- **Logo returns you to the start.** Clicking the featherdrop logo goes back to
  the start screen — it resets the upload on the home page, and links home from a
  download page.
- **Clearer, more professional copy.** The headline, subtitle, drop zone, result
  and download wording were rewritten to say plainly what featherdrop does:
  encrypted at rest, automatically deleted on expiry, no account needed. The
  result page also shows that reassurance. English and German are refreshed; the
  other languages keep their existing translations until they're updated.
